hero.intro: SEO Executive with 2+ years of hands-on experience in international and performance-focused SEO. Currently managing international SEO activities at RankON Technologies with a focus on organic visibility, rankings, and sustainable search growth.

summary: SEO Executive with 2+ years of hands-on experience in international and performance-focused SEO.
Experienced in keyword research, on-page optimization, technical SEO, content optimization, link building, competitor analysis, SEO audits, and Google Search Console/GA4 reporting.
Currently managing international SEO activities at RankON Technologies with a focus on organic visibility, rankings, and sustainable search growth.

highlights: Manage international SEO campaigns for overseas clients, supporting organic growth, search visibility, keyword rankings, and market-specific SEO strategies.
Conduct comprehensive keyword research, competitor analysis, search-intent mapping, content gap analysis, and initial ranking analysis to identify high-value opportunities.

Execute on-page and technical SEO, including meta tags, canonicalization, URL structure, heading optimization, content and image optimization, website speed, robots.txt, XML sitemaps, crawlability, indexation, and structured data recommendations.
Perform content optimization for existing pages and blogs, providing data-driven recommendations to improve relevance, search intent alignment, topical coverage, and organic visibility.

Develop and execute off-page SEO and link-building strategies, including guest posting, link insertions, resource link building, broken link building, link roundups, competitor backlink research, and digital outreach.
Conduct email outreach and prospect research to acquire relevant, high-quality backlinks while evaluating website authority, relevance, traffic, and backlink quality.
Support local SEO activities including Google Business Profile optimization, Google Maps integration, local citations, and local classified submissions where applicable.
Monitor SEO performance using Google Search Console, GA4, Semrush, SE Ranking, and Ahrefs, tracking keyword rankings, organic performance, backlinks, and campaign progress.
Prepare and share monthly SEO reports and actionable recommendations, including keyword ranking, Google Analytics, Search Console, and acquired-link reports.
Perform website and competitor analysis, content duplicity checks, SEO audits, and technical reviews to identify issues and prioritize optimization opportunities.
Developed and executed SEO strategies for healthcare and doctor websites, covering on-page, technical, content, local, and off-page SEO.
Achieved Top 5 Google rankings for targeted healthcare keywords, improving organic visibility and qualified traffic.
Conducted comprehensive SEO audits and implemented optimization strategies using Google Search Console and Google Analytics.
Optimized website elements including title tags, meta descriptions, headings, content, internal linking, site structure, and technical SEO factors.
Performed YouTube SEO for doctors and healthcare channels, optimizing video titles, descriptions, keywords, tags, and content structure to improve YouTube search visibility.
Conducted keyword research and content optimization to target health-related search queries and patient-focused topics.
Collaborated with content and development teams to implement SEO recommendations aligned with organic growth and business goals.
Performed keyword research and implemented on-page SEO best practices to improve organic visibility.
Executed link-building campaigns and technical SEO improvements focused on crawlability and website performance.
Prepared SEO reports and insights for clients and supported ongoing optimization planning.
